mentions.name: Peanut
mentions.description: This product provides modern, self-custodial money movement, letting users move and control their own funds without relying on custodial banks. The author notes its relevance in light of the recent Ueno Bank collapse in Paraguay.
mentions.problem: Dependence on custodial banks, highlighted by the recent Ueno Bank collapse in Paraguay.
